purpose.objective: Use actual Jev-1.14 judgments to compare source-backed grade-3 multiplication, division and circle questions against detailed research analyses, then propose exactly24 unique eligible questions with native difficulty middle/high/highest and transparent similarity evidence.
successCriteria: Actual question content, explanation/diagram evidence and original identities are available, not labels alone.
Exact model typesafe-ai/jev-1.14.0 is used and the returned model, input revisions, judgments, abstentions and cost are retained.
Difficulty raw codes are owner-qualified as 중/상/최상; below-middle and unknown are excluded rather than relabelled.
A deterministic selection has24 unique actual source questions, reports subject/difficulty distribution and distinguishes points from difficulty.
Unresolved subject/difficulty quotas and duplicate/near-duplicate policy are interviewed by the WorkLead, not silently defaulted.
inScope: Source-grounded WorkLead handoff, owned implementation planning and verification for this assigned Work.
Native owners retain tools/runtime/credentials; roots: apps/academy/month-end-workbench
outOfScope: Root orchestrator performing the domain implementation instead of the WorkLead.
Student records/DB mutation, SQL, official save, generation, print, send or production deployment.
Reusing completed runs/effects or prior ODI Jev budget/ledger.
